title: Direct-image coordinate comparison on diagonal-supported objects
statement:
Let \(A\) be a finite commutative ring and \(f:X\to Y\) proper. Write \(\Delta:X\to X\times_Y X\) for the diagonal, \(p_1,p_2\) for the projections, \(F=Rf_!\), and \(S=R\Delta_!\). Let \(\alpha_1=\operatorname{diagonalFirst}\), \(\alpha_2=\operatorname{idIsoDiagonalSnd}\), and \(c=\operatorname{directComparison}\) be the canonical maps of [def-sf-supported-diagonal-calculus]. For every \(M\in D_A(X)\),
\[
F(\alpha_{2,M});c_{S(M)}=F(\alpha_{1,M}).
\]
This is an equality involving only direct images and their canonical identity and composition comparisons.

proof.text: Identify the inverse of rightDerivedLowerShriekCompIso with the explicitly constructed unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso by expanding only the three compactification-comparison factors. Through a proof-only import all, use the already proved unboundedFormalism, its base-change and proper-exchange instances, and unbounded_chosen_comp. Apply CompactSupportFormalism.lowerShriekCompIso_assoc to the three proper maps. Equality induction identifies its lowerShriekCongr with rightDerivedLowerShriekCongrIso. Evaluate the resulting natural-transformation equality at M and transport the composite morphisms to the named maps. This gives associativity for the collapse isomorphisms from push(f) push(g) to push(h), where h=f≫g. The private formalism has no Noetherian assumption, so none is introduced.

Apply this transported associativity to Delta,p1,f and Delta,p2,f, using Delta≫pi=id, p1≫f=p2≫f, and id≫f=f. Both equations have a common final collapse for Delta,p2≫f and a common collapse for id,f. Cancel these isomorphisms in the elementary compare_sections identity. Precompose with push(f) of the inverse canonical identity comparison, and expand diagonalFirst, idIsoDiagonalSnd, and directComparison. Congruence along the reverse equality is the inverse congruence, by equality induction, so this is exactly the claimed equation. No identity-composition normalization is needed: the same id,f comparison cancels on both sides.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalPushComparison (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X) :
    (push A f).map ((TraceDiagonalDatum.idIsoDiagonalSnd (Λ := A) f).hom.app M) ≫
        (directComparison A f).hom.app ((push A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).obj M) =
      (push A f).map ((SfDiagonalKernel.diagonalFirst A f).hom.app M)
